name: @douxing/or-tools
description: 兜行路径优化：消费 PyPI ortools 的 Python 产品仓（yxtao-lab/python-route-solver）

scripts.upstream:status: git -C upstream status -sb && git -C upstream rev-parse --short HEAD && git -C upstream remote -v
scripts.info: node -e "console.log('@douxing/or-tools -> https://github.com/yxtao-lab/python-route-solver'); console.log('submodule', require('child_process').execSync('git -C upstream rev-parse --short HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim())"
